texts.zh: 当特工在稳步进入[from.target.GetName]更加戒备森严的区域时，我们失去了与其的联系。我们搞不好会全部交代在这里。这样的信号中断可能是马虎的[from.target.GetAdj]启动了屏蔽科技，隔断了我们的噪声干涉。
texts.en: We are losing contact with our operatives as they enter steadily more secure areas in the [from.target.GetName]. There is a chance we could lose our presence there altogether. These interruptions are likely caused by sloppy [from.target.GetAdj] shielding technology putting out noisy interference.

label.zh: 我们应当尝试并去适应。
label.en: We shall have to try and adapt.

label.zh: 让他们自己的硬件转而对付他们。
label.en: Turn their own hardware against them.

texts.zh:
我们失去了指派给对于[fromfrom.target.GetName]的[fromfrom.GetName]行动中所有人员的联系。无论是被我们的目标算计，还是单纯遇到了不幸的巧合，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的屏蔽科技都是一个相当棘手的对手。

[fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName]在这场事件中存在获得收益的可能性。尽管我们的特工[GetOperativesLowerPlural]能够做到半自主，但是没有了我们的出面引导，这些子个体可能会更加容易落到敌人手中。
texts.en:
We have lost all contact with our operatives assigned to Operation [fromfrom.GetName] in the [fromfrom.target.GetName]. Whether by our target's cunning design, or simply an unlucky coincidence for us, [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] shielding technology has proven a worthy adversary us.

It is possible the [fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName] may gain from this incident. Although our [GetOperativesLowerPlural] may operate semi-autonomously, without our presence they are still far more vulnerable to enemy capture.
